question: Should maintainers accept this Signal setup direction and upgrade behavior now, including account-scoped apiMode, setupApplied rollback, receive probing, and no OpenClaw-managed Signal Docker setup path?
rationale: The patch appears coherent, but it changes user-facing setup/config behavior and Signal receive transport selection; automation cannot decide the permanent product and upgrade contract for existing Signal operators.

options.title: Accept Current Direction
options.body: Land after exact-head merge readiness if maintainers accept plugin-owned Signal setup and the documented no-managed-Docker setup path.

options.title: Require Live Signal Proof
options.body: Ask for redacted terminal output or logs showing native and existing-server setup against a real Signal helper before merge.

options.title: Split The Risk
options.body: Separate the generic setupApplied core contract from the Signal wizard if maintainers want smaller independently reviewable changes.

recommendation.title: Accept Current Direction
recommendation.body: Land after exact-head merge readiness if maintainers accept plugin-owned Signal setup and the documented no-managed-Docker setup path.
